plan.notes: Sequence transcribed from the official current Program Guide PDF (Program Guide link on the official program page, anokatech.edu/programs/emergency-medical-technician/, retrieved 2026-10-01). The PDF template header prints '2023-2024'; the guide is the currently published program guide and its program name, sequence, and 9-credit total match the current official programs listing. Program starts Fall (August) and Spring (January). All courses required for this program must be completed with a grade of C or higher. The EMT program follows the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration curriculum and is approved by the State of Minnesota Emergency Medical Services Regulatory Board (EMSRB). Offered at Anoka Technical College and the Anoka-Ramsey Community College Cambridge Campus. Minnesota law requires a background study for direct patient/resident contact.
